subject: general
question:
Select the correct word:

The startup grew so quickly that its infrastructure could ________ keep up.
solution:
The correct answer is '**barely**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "**barely**" means "only just" or "by a very small margin," showing that something is almost not possible. (मुश्किल से / बस-बस)
 
• In the sentence, the startup grew very quickly, so the infrastructure could "*barely keep up*," meaning it was struggling to match the pace.
 
• Options 2, 3, and 4 do not express the sense of difficulty as accurately as "**barely**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The startup grew so quickly that its infrastructure could **barely**__ keep up."* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2: "simply"** (सिर्फ / मात्र) – does not indicate difficulty; it changes the meaning.
 
• **Option 3: "hardly"** (मुश्किल से) – close in meaning but grammatically less natural here because "could hardly keep up" is possible but "barely" fits more smoothly.
 
• **Option 4: "almost"** (लगभग) – does not convey struggle; meaning becomes unclear.

1b3:Tbb0,

The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Censu
